scripts.release:major: pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version major --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:minor: pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:patch: pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
